### $k_{max}$

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/kmax.qmd",
  stem = .composeTargetStem("kmax-flexible"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    MODELS = c(rigid = "Rigid Models", flexible = "Flexible Models", ensemble = "Ensemble Models"),
    CAP = readCaption("fig.kmax"),
    CAP.MCE = readCaption("fig.kmax.MCE"),
    p.target = "mean",
    IDn.target = "flexible"
  ),
  root = root
)
```
